video.title: How I Avoided Blue Belt Blues in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
video.description:
Blue belt brought a gym change, a rebuilt top game, injuries, cross-training, competition, and the challenge that makes people leave Brazilian jiu-jitsu. In episode two of The BJJ Belt Journey, I explain how aiming at the next level kept me moving through the blue belt blues—and share one competition-day nutrition mistake I never repeated.

More from Toby on Fitness Tech: https://tobyonfitnesstech.com
